turns.question: In what share of our customer calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 did the customer raise an objection?
turns.answer: The objection rate was 33.3% of labelled calls on 1 and 2 October 2026 (model-derived, labelled by gemini-3.5-flash). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
